name: pwnfactor
description: Agentic engineering harness - a feature lifecycle spine, deliberate subagent orchestration, a risk-routed multi-agent review panel, a ground-truth validation gate, a read-only pre-prod security sweep, red-then-green TDD, deliberate compaction, and system cards - installable into any project.

plugins.name: pwnfactor
plugins.description: Feature lifecycle + risk-routed review panel (code-review / simplifier / security Claude agents + optional Codex cross-model review) + a ground-truth validation gate + deliberate subagent-orchestration playbook + a read-only pre-prod security sweep + system cards (per-subsystem contracts and decisions, checker-enforced) + tdd (red-then-green with mutation proof) + compact (compaction at task boundaries, context audit). Token-efficient, safety-rail aware, works in solo mode with no backend.
